name: Can I add a shower niche when converting my bathtub to a shower?

mainEntity.name: Can I add a shower niche when converting my bathtub to a shower?

acceptedAnswer.text:
A niche can be added during a tub-to-shower conversion, but its placement must be coordinated with the new shower footprint, plumbing, wall framing, waterproofing, and tile layout. The conversion may involve more than inserting a storage box into the existing wall.

Key factors:
- The former tub wall may contain plumbing or framing that limits recess depth.
- The new showerhead, valve, drain, and door change the available wall area.
- A niche may be easier to plan after the new layout is established.

Practical guidance: Include the niche in the initial tub-removal and bathroom-layout discussion with Elite Remodeling & Design. Approve its dimensions before wall waterproofing and tile work begin, and ask whether a ledge or surface-mounted option offers better storage if the old tub wall is crowded.

Early coordination prevents the niche from becoming an expensive late change.
